state.EXPIRING.summary.text: Still expected to read the cache if sent before {time}.

state.UNCERTAIN.summary.text: Near the expiry boundary: whether the next request reads the cache is a coin flip.

state.INVALIDATED.summary.text: A rebuild is expected regardless of time: {cause}.

state.COLD.summary.text: The cache expired at {time}; the next prompt is expected to re-cache {tokens} tokens.

lever.continue.when.text: Keep going in this conversation; the cost depends on whether the cache is still warm.

lever.compact.when.text: Shrinks the prefix to a summary: one rebuild now, cheaper turns after.

lever.clear.when.text: Starts fresh when you're changing tasks; throws away the conversation, so it is never recommended on cost alone.

lever.rewind.when.text: Returns to an earlier point whose cache entry may still be warm.

lever.recap.when.text: Cache-safe, not cache-saving: it neither invalidates the cache nor shrinks the prefix.

lever.btw.when.text: A side question that never enters history; cheap while the cache is warm.

lever.keepalive.when.text: Refreshes the cache while you're away, up to an end time and a budget.

lever.probe.when.text: Measures whether the cache is warm, at the price of one request, and leaves it warm either way.

lever.ttl.when.text: Changes the cache lifetime for later writes.

lever.model.when.text: Switching rebuilds the cache on the target model.

recommend.continue.expiring.text: Send before {time} to keep the cache.

recommend.none.unknown_costs.text: No recommendation: none of the options could be priced.

effect.compact.text: prefix shrinks to the system layer plus a summary

effect.clear.text: prefix shrinks to the system layer; the conversation is gone

effect.rewind.text: prefix shrinks to that earlier point

effect.keepalive.text: keeps the cache warm until the end time

effect.probe.text: measures the cache and refreshes its expiry

effect.ttl.text: changes the lifetime of later cache writes

effect.rebuild.text: rebuilds the prefix on the new setting

gate.hold.text: Token Shield: cache {state} ({detail}). This prompt is expected to re-cache {tokens} tokens {approx} {cost}. Press Enter again within 60 s to send it anyway, or {lever} first.

gate.warn.text: Token Shield: cache {state}. This prompt is expected to re-cache {tokens} tokens {approx} {cost}.

guard.switch.toast.text: Token Shield: switching to {model} rebuilds the cache ({tokens} tokens) {approx} {cost}.

guard.switch.alternative.text: Cheaper for a one-off task: run it in a subagent on {model}.

guard.switch.confirm_reason.text: Token Shield: this switch rebuilds the cache ({tokens} tokens), {approx} {cost}.

guard.effort.toast.text: Token Shield: this effort change rebuilds the cache on the next request {approx} {cost}.

guard.fast.toast.text: Token Shield: toggling fast mode rebuilds the cache on the next request {approx} {cost}.

guard.reload.toast.text: Token Shield: reloading plugins may rebuild the cache if tool definitions change.

resume.options.text: Options: continue, /compact, /clear with a handoff, or /recap first.

notify.ttl_bucket_change.text: Token Shield: now billing usage credits, so new cache writes use the 5-minute TTL.

notify.uncertain.text: Token Shield: cache near its expiry; whether the next request reads it is uncertain.

notify.invalidated.text: Token Shield: {cause} invalidated the cache; the next request rebuilds it.

notify.gate_held.text: Token Shield: prompt held before a {usd} rebuild.

notify.calibration_drift.text: Token Shield: recent cache behavior differs from its stated rates; intervals widened.

error.version.text: Token Shield needs Claude Code v{version} or later; cache features are off.

error.config_invalid.text: Token Shield: setting {key} is invalid; using the default ({default}).

error.bridge_unavailable.text: Token Shield: the statusline bridge isn't set up, so native cache data is unavailable. Run /cache-check setup.

error.probe_needs_mod.text: An exact-prefix probe needs the Token Shield mod inside a session; no request was made.

segment.COLD.text: {glyph} cache COLD since {time} {dot} next prompt re-caches {tokens}

check.next_turn_unknown.text: cost unknown for this model; {tokens} tokens re-cached if cold

check.probe_hint.text: --probe costs {approx} {warm} if warm, {approx} {cold} if cold, and leaves the cache warm either way.

check.timeline_head.text: start     gap      read     write    input   outcome

check.no_changes.text: no changes between the last two requests and nothing pending

check.miss_causes.text: Claude Code's diagnosis of the last miss: {causes}

check.cli_gap.text: tshield reads Claude Code's snapshot and the recorded history only; events the mod sees live since the last request (model, effort or fast-mode switches, plugin reloads) are not included here.

band.EXPIRING.text: Token Shield {dot} cache warm until {time}; send before then, or the next prompt re-caches {tokens} tokens{cost}.

band.COLD.text: Token Shield {dot} cache cold; the next prompt re-caches {tokens} tokens{cost}.

band.INVALIDATED.text: Token Shield {dot} {cause} invalidated the cache; the next prompt re-caches {tokens} tokens{cost}.

command.unknown_option.text: Token Shield: unknown /cache-check option {option}. Try --verbose, --diff or setup.

command.off.text: Token Shield: cache features are off ({reason}).

command.mid_turn.text: Token Shield: the cache check is in the Token Shield pane while the turn runs.

levers.fill.text: Puts {command} in the prompt; press Enter to run it.

setup.confirm.text: Token Shield {dot} set up the statusline bridge? It keeps your current statusline and shows the cache segment beside it.

setup.no_binary.text: Token Shield: the tshield binary isn't available on this machine, so the bridge can't be set up here.

setup.done.text: Token Shield: the statusline bridge is set up.

setup.cancelled.text: Token Shield: setup cancelled; nothing was changed.

lever.failed.text: Token Shield: {command} didn't run ({reason}); nothing was changed.

setting.confirm.text: Token Shield {dot} set {key} to {value} in your user settings ({file})?

setting.changed.text: Token Shield: {file} changed after it was shown, so nothing was written. Run the lever again to see it as it is now.

setting.paste.text: Token Shield: couldn't write {file} ({reason}). To make the change yourself, add {snippet}

command.ttl_usage.text: Token Shield: /cache-check ttl [--since 30d] shows the TTL advisor; /cache-check ttl 5m|1h [--subagent] sets the TTL after you confirm.

driver.resume.text: resumed or forked session: timing from the last response and the last recorded TTL

probe.confirm.text: Token Shield {dot} probe now? It re-sends the cached prefix ({tokens} tokens) with a one-line prompt: {approx} {warm} if warm, {approx} {cold} if cold, and the cache is warm afterwards either way.

probe.decline_lost.text: Token Shield: no probe: the cache is already lost, so a probe would just pay the rebuild. Add --force to probe anyway.

probe.decline_hot.text: Token Shield: no probe: the cache is warm with more than 5 minutes left, so a probe would only confirm it. Add --force to probe anyway.

probe.result.text: Token Shield: probe {outcome}: {read} tokens read from cache, {write} written, {uncached} uncached; cost {cost}. Warm until {time}.

probe.nothing.text: Token Shield: no probe was possible: there is no request to fork yet (or the conversation was cleared). Nothing was sent.

probe.failed.text: Token Shield: the probe didn't complete ({reason}); nothing changed.

probe.cancelled.text: Token Shield: probe cancelled; nothing was sent.

keepalive.confirm.text: Token Shield {dot} keep the cache warm until {until}, spending at most {budget}? About {n} refreshes at {approx} {each} each, {approx} {total} in all. Sending a prompt stops it.

keepalive.running.text: Token Shield {dot} keeping the cache warm until {until}: {spent} of {budget} spent, next refresh {next}.

keepalive.stopped.prompt.text: Token Shield: keep-alive stopped because you're back; it spent {spent}.

keepalive.stopped.budget.text: Token Shield: keep-alive stopped: the next refresh could pass the {budget} budget; it spent {spent}.

keepalive.stopped.end.text: Token Shield: keep-alive finished at {until}; it spent {spent}.

keepalive.stopped.miss.text: Token Shield: keep-alive stopped: a refresh found the cache already lost; it spent {spent}.

keepalive.stopped.failed.text: Token Shield: keep-alive stopped: a refresh didn't complete ({reason}); it spent {spent}.

keepalive.stopped.user.text: Token Shield: keep-alive stopped; it spent {spent}.

keepalive.usage.text: Token Shield: /cache-check keepalive [until HH:MM | for <minutes>m] [max $<amount>], or keepalive stop.

keepalive.refused_lost.text: Token Shield: no keep-alive: the cache is already lost, so a refresh would pay the rebuild.

keepalive.refused_unpriced.text: Token Shield: no keep-alive: the refresh price isn't known here, so a budget can't be kept.

keepalive.refused_none.text: Token Shield: no keep-alive: no refresh fits before {until} within {budget}.

keepalive.not_running.text: Token Shield: no keep-alive is running.
